scope: Read-only source-field audit of all 14 sub and 19 special selectable catalogue modules. The 33 raw parameter tables are inventoried; supporting DamageRateInfo and WeaponInfo selector receipts are tracked separately. A complete raw leaf inventory is not a claim that every engine field is a gameplay requirement or that each mapping matches retail.
method: Each extracted scalar leaf is retained with its source value. Audited rows identify runtime consumer, missing source behavior, or unresolved semantics; code-consumed values without a focused assertion are labeled separately. Nested arrays/objects may be aggregated in audited rows. Distances are only converted where source-specific unit evidence supports it; 60 Hz frame scaling and /10 damage normalization are not applied blindly. Source-value consumption, regression coverage, engine mapping, and retail parity are distinct claims.
completion: NOT_COMPLETE: known public values now consume source launch speed, gravity, air resistance, hook outbound timing and rut/splash paint tiers. Target acquisition/distributions, panel responses, undefined engine fields, calibrated splash landing geometry and retail physics/collision/world mapping remain unresolved; source consumption is not retail parity.

summary.note: Raw source leaf counts describe extracted data only. Audited field records may cover multiple raw scalar leaves; every remaining scalar leaf is listed once as unreviewed and separated into probable presentation/metadata versus gameplay-or-engine relevance unclassified. These counts are not gameplay feature requirements and do not certify runtime/retail parity.

sourceUsageDefinitions.used: The exact source field/value is read or directly represented by a runtime consumer.

sourceUsageDefinitions.mismatch: A current value/mapping conflicts with the source or accepted measurement.
sourceUsageDefinitions.not_proven: The field’s gameplay semantics or runtime use could not be established.
sourceUsageDefinitions.absent: The queried field does not exist in the extracted table; any runtime value comes from a separate gameplay reference or fallback.
sourceUsageDefinitions.interpretation: Runtime or Wiki interpretation is represented, but the extracted field semantics cannot be stated as an exact engine mapping; do not treat it as retail-confirmed.
sourceUsageDefinitions.unconsumed_visual: No runtime consumer was found for a field whose name/value suggests presentation-only behavior; this is inventoried separately from gameplay gaps unless evidence shows a gameplay effect.
sourceUsageDefinitions.testStatus: Optional per-row evidence note. Code consumer observed without a focused regression is explicitly not regression-proven; a passing test establishes that the runtime path behaves as tested, not that it matches retail.
